{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) stands in solidarity with 110,000 UK postal workers represented by the Communication Workers Union (CWU).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Royal Mail Group was recently privatized by a Conservative-Liberal Democrat coalition government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Communication Workers Union (CWU)’s previous “Four Pillars” contract with the Royal Mail Group provided for pay increases.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Communication Workers Union (CWU)’s previous “Four Pillars” contract with the Royal Mail Group provided for pension reforms.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Communication Workers Union (CWU)’s previous “Four Pillars” contract with the Royal Mail Group provided for a path to a 35-hour standard workweek for all full-time employees with no loss of pay by 2022.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A strike ballot vote pushed the previous management of the Royal Mail Group to make significant concessions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Rico Back leads a newly appointed board of the Royal Mail Group.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The newly appointed board led by Rico Back has reneged on the contract with the Communication Workers Union (CWU).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The newly appointed board led by Rico Back seeks to enable investors to strip the Royal Mail Group’s assets.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The newly appointed board led by Rico Back plans to divide the Royal Mail Group’s workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The newly appointed board led by Rico Back plans to crush or lay off workers who remain.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"If successful, the new management could break the power of one of the UK’s most militant and socialist unions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The new management will not succeed in breaking the power of one of the UK’s most militant and socialist unions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Communication Workers Union (CWU) has balloted its members for a strike and won a larger mandate than last time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Communication Workers Union (CWU) received a 97.1% “Yes” vote on a 76% turnout in the strike ballot.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"If the strike goes ahead, it could be the largest private-sector strike in recent memory.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The strike is led by an openly socialist union leadership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The strike is backed by a confident mass socialist movement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
